create.name: Melissa Ambrosini
create.bio:
Melissa Ambrosini is an Australian author, podcast host and speaker whose work centres on self-worth, quietening the inner critic and living with purpose. Earlier in life she was a professional dancer, including at the Moulin Rouge in Paris, as well as an actress and television presenter. When the pace of that life caught up with her, she turned to meditation, inner work and a simpler daily rhythm, and those practices became the ground of everything she has made since. She lives in Noosa, Queensland, with her husband and co-author Nick Broadhurst and their children.

Her books include Mastering Your Mean Girl, on taming self-criticism; Open Wide, on love and relationships; Comparisonitis, on breaking the habit of measuring yourself against others; and Time Magic, written with Nick, about taking back your time, which was named Australian Business Book of the Year. She hosts The Melissa Ambrosini Show, a long-running podcast of conversations about mindset, spirituality and relationships, and has spoken at TEDx about the inner critic. Meditation is part of her own morning, and she offers several guided meditation collections as well as a six-month mastermind for women building their public work. Her Insight Timer meditations focus on self-love, worth and manifestation.

books.title: Mastering Your Mean Girl: The No-BS Guide to Silencing Your Inner Critic and Becoming Wildly Wealthy, Fabulously Healthy, and Bursting with Love
books.author: Melissa Ambrosini
books.description: Her first book, about recognising the harsh inner voice that holds people back and learning to answer it with self-love. It mixes her own story with exercises and daily practices.

books.title: Open Wide: A Radically Real Guide to Deep Love, Rocking Relationships, and Soulful Sex
books.author: Melissa Ambrosini
books.description: A frank guide to intimacy that starts with the relationship you have with yourself and moves on to partners, communication and sex. Draws on her own marriage and on conversations with experts.

books.title: Comparisonitis: How to Stop Comparing Yourself To Others and Be Genuinely Happy
books.author: Melissa Ambrosini
books.description: Looks at why people measure themselves against others, especially online, and offers practical steps for breaking the habit and living by your own standards.

books.title: Time Magic: Reclaim Your Time, Reclaim Your Life
books.author: Melissa Ambrosini, Nick Broadhurst
books.description: Written with her husband Nick Broadhurst, a book about rethinking how you spend your hours so there is room for what matters. Combines time-management methods with mindset work.

courses.title: The ICONIC Mastermind
courses.description: A six-month mastermind for women who want to become better known for their work, with weekly support from Melissa and an advisory board. A twelve-month private mentoring option for a handful of women is offered on the same page at $30,000 USD.

courses.title: SHE Meditates
courses.description: A library of 29 guided meditations, from three-minute resets to twenty-minute practices, on themes such as worth, self-love and abundance, plus ten wordless Deep States tracks. Lifetime access through her app.

courses.title: Mastering Your Mean Girl Meditations
courses.description: Ten guided meditations made as an audio companion to her first book, each on one theme such as love over fear, purpose, letting go and authenticity.

courses.title: Deep States
courses.description: Ten wordless soundscapes for meditation, layered with binaural beats and solfeggio tones, for when you want to sit without spoken guidance.

courses.title: The Dream Life Manifestation Kit
courses.description: A guided visualisation plus a workbook and video walk-through for reviewing nine areas of life and choosing next steps. Designed to be repeated whenever you want to reset.

courses.title: Higher Self Meditation
courses.description: A fifteen-minute higher-self visualisation Melissa uses each morning, set to layered tones, with notes on building it into a daily routine.

free_resources.title: Melissa Ambrosini on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Free guided meditations from Melissa on self-love, worth and manifestation, available to play on Insight Timer.

flags: Email hello@melissaambrosini.com is a brand inbox, decoded from Cloudflare email protection on the contact page (pr@ is also listed for press).

Her current paid work is mostly business and visibility mentoring for women (ICONIC) and meditation downloads; she is closer to a self-help author and podcaster than a spiritual teacher, so a human may want to confirm she fits.
Open Wide's amazon.com /dp/1948836165 page returned 500 twice; the ASIN comes from the amazon.com link on her own Open Wide page.
Mastering Your Mean Girl's subtitle includes 'Fabulously Healthy' and Comparisonitis is framed as a 'condition' on her site; both kept as they name no medical condition, but borderline.

Her YouTube channel is mostly pregnancy vlogs and podcast clips; videos chosen are mainly her TEDx talk and interviews or solo episodes where she is the main speaker (several hosted on other channels).
Possible overlap with Nick Broadhurst (husband, co-author of Time Magic, co-host on some episodes).
